sources.section: 7.0, affix scope in Slots V and VII
authored computational design; not donor-language fact

concepts.name: DN: naming / designation / labeling
concepts.note: Abstract root; do not collapse to English noun/verb polarity.

concepts.name: DN Stem Zero: deliberate undifferentiation
concepts.note: Undifferentiated choice across DN stems; not equivalent to any one stem.

concepts.name: DN Stem 1: name / naming
concepts.note: Nominal and verbal manifestations may both be licensed.

concepts.name: DN Stem 2: designation / reference
concepts.note: Source distinguishes this from Stem 1 and Stem 3.

concepts.name: DN Stem 3: label / labeling
concepts.note: Source distinguishes the label interpretation.

concepts.name: Basic
concepts.note: Holistic instantiation.

concepts.name: Contential
concepts.note: Content, essence or intended semantic function in contrast to realization.

concepts.name: Constitutive
concepts.note: Form or actual realization in contrast to functional content.

concepts.name: Objective
concepts.note: Stem-governed salient instrument/associated object/result/patient, not a universal object relation.

concepts.name: Nominal interpretation
concepts.note: Contextual manifestation of a formative, not a distinct innate root class.

concepts.name: Verbal interpretation
concepts.note: Contextual manifestation of a formative, not an unrelated lexical root.

concepts.name: Slot II: Stem and Version
concepts.note: Stem identity and Version; shortcut interactions require separate codec work.

concepts.name: Slot III: Root
concepts.note: Consonantal root.

concepts.name: Slot IV: Function, Specification, Context
concepts.note: Several categories packed into slot; not a single semantically atomic feature.

concepts.name: Slot V: stem-level affixes
concepts.note: Scope applies to stem, distinct from Slot VII.

concepts.name: Slot VI: CA complex
concepts.note: Five independent semantic categories share a morphological complex.

concepts.name: Slot VII: stem plus CA affixes
concepts.note: Placement changes semantic scope; not a commutative bag of suffixes.

concepts.name: Configuration
concepts.note: Number, resemblance and connectedness arrangements; not merely cardinality.

concepts.name: Affiliation
concepts.note: Functional coordination of members; not graph connectivity.

concepts.name: Extension
concepts.note: Portion or phase of referent, distinct from Perspective.

concepts.name: Perspective
concepts.note: Scope of treatment, not simple plural count.

concepts.name: Essence
concepts.note: Normal versus representative reference; not true versus false.

concepts.name: Recognize root-to-stem distinctions
concepts.note: Initial differentiated and underspecified identities.

concepts.name: Compose stem with Specification
concepts.note: Return a structured AST, not a Boolean-only guess.

concepts.name: Contrast nominal/verbal manifestation
concepts.note: Retain earlier levels; test role of mode without redefining root identity.

concepts.name: Add affix scope and context
concepts.note: Designed only; no admitted executable lexical oracle in v0.1.
